scope: Initial alphabetic-language bootstrap map accepted in PR #132. No persistent records allocated by the map; writer/schema implementation and target-store population evidence remain separately reviewed.
initial_component_order: Alphabet members first, then remaining punctuation members; exact Unicode scalar sequence within each set. This is bootstrap slot order, not linguistic collation.
extension_policy: Retain every assigned address in a ledger; append new components into unused slots. Never renumber existing endpoints on rerun.
regional_scope: Only the existing English variant group placeholders are mapped. No regional letter inventory or lexical fallback is added.
classification_scope: Practical provisional groupings for this batch, not a claim that these are all human language families or a finalized evolutionary tree. Other families and scripts remain unallocated.
